recognize_zh: 肝細胞索之間的竇狀隙明顯被撐開，裡面塞滿混合的造血細胞：核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻的未成熟髓系/單核系細胞、深染小圓核的紅血球前驅細胞與帶狀或分節核的中性球；這種竇狀隙浸潤型態符合 JMML 侵犯肝臟。
features: Hepatic sinusoids markedly distended by a hematopoietic infiltrate between preserved hepatocyte plates
Immature myelomonocytic cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Admixed erythroid precursors with small, round, hyperchromatic nuclei
Hepatocytes with granular pale cytoplasm and intact architecture
describe_en: H&E section of liver shows preserved hepatocyte plates with markedly distended sinusoids containing a mixed hematopoietic infiltrate. The infiltrate includes immature myelomonocytic cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with erythroid precursors bearing small dense nuclei and scattered band and segmented granulocytes. There are no sheets of blasts and no discrete mass. In the appropriate clinical and molecular context, findings are consistent with sinusoidal hepatic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Trilineage with megakaryocytes and erythroid islands and no monocytic predominance; clinical setting (anemia, marrow fibrosis, neonate) and absence of a clonal RAS-pathway lesion distinguish it.
Also sinusoidal, but cells are monotonous medium-sized CD3+ γδ T cells without maturing granulocytes or erythroid precursors.
Sinusoids contain activated histiocytes with hemophagocytosis rather than a maturing myelomonocytic proliferation.

ddx.dx: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis / AMKL in Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Infiltrate is dominated by megakaryoblasts with associated hepatic fibrosis.
